#### neumannEllipse (quasistationary)

The ellipse geometry of `quasistationary/dirichletEllipse` with traction
boundaries: all three contours are handled by
`StationaryLinearElasticityMRTNeumannValidation`, which prescribes the stress
of the manufactured solution. The outer contour is flagged as such, the two
inner ones as holes, so the normals point the right way on each of them.

The `run.sh` script performs the same resolution sweep and order of convergence
study as `quasistationary/periodicPlate`.
